items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I played with a guy across the river and he had a funeral you'd better know how to read when you go there. That was old man Henry Allen.

ctx.x: Did you ever play funeral marching? Oh, yeah.

Oh, yeah. I played with a guy across the river and he had a funeral you'd better know how to read when you go there. That was old man Henry Allen. Oh, yes. You played Henry Allen's band then, too. You heard him, man. Yeah, he had nothing but real funeral march. Yeah. That Flea's a Bird. I done played at him many times. Oh, then. Didn't he ramble? That was Chris' place when he turned you loose when he's coming back. That was his piece. Didn't he ramble? Ramble come to put his cutting down.
Well, did he... I guess he wouldn't use his boots on a parade.
